title: ribes alpinum f. pumilum
intro: Ribes alpinum f. pumilum, commonly known as Alpine Currant, is a compact, deciduous shrub that belongs to the Grossulariaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to support digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ribes alpinum f. pumilum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
